# Task Specification

## 目标

Add a closed installed-engine mutation primitive that executes and independently replays five fixed probes against the ordinary wheel bytes, without enabling public Node V2 or CI.

## 范围

Only src/aiflow/installed_mutations.py and src/aiflow/installed_probe.py implement behavior. The initial companion tests and design are separate task-free commits in this genuine pre-source baseline; neither production module exists in the base. Preserve the blocked TASK-0134 prototype history through a normal merge without rewriting its frozen spec or records. It launched no actual installed pairs or mutation action. Imported prototype code remains wholly inside the new production diff. The four exact companion-test paths and design-document path listed in allowed_scope permit transport of independent task-free maintenance commits only; they are not implementation ownership of this governed source task. Keep tests/docs in separate commits, do not use this source approval as their task authority, and do not expand these transport paths. All source lines remain under unchanged90percent diff coverage, including later corrections.

Follow docs/superpowers/specs/installed-engine-governance-mutations.md at the frozen baseline. Reuse existing installed inventories, budgets, copies, generic action normalization/approval matching, task consumption lock, Windows Job process execution and four compatible native AST operators. Do not change native mutation behavior. The installed 001 operator retains the complete extras declaration and positive control, relaxing only the unique fixed comparison to admit exactly the missing-targeted alternative. Reject ambiguous, unsupported or unrelated AST shapes and preserve outside-target AST.

Expose only the four closed operations and declared immutable types in the baseline design: prepare_installed_mutations, record_installed_mutations, collect_installed_mutation_current and replay_installed_mutations. Stable InstalledMutationInputs bind execution/action facts; InstalledMutationCurrent separately binds those inputs, the exact reference (ref/size/SHA), canonical complete current root-snapshot bytes and a sorted unique tuple of exact collector-verified Git paths. Mutable HEAD/index/events/approval/metadata facts must not enter the stable action-input digest or make an approval invalidate itself. Preparation validates current IMPLEMENTING native V2 task, spec approval, classification, distinct actual actor labels, current verifier context and ordinary installed materials. Its canonical inputs bind all task/version facts, full installed distribution/dependency/startup/RECORD bytes, supported interpreter/host identity, fixed probe/protocol/operator bytes. Preparation consumes nothing and creates no run.

Recording revalidates the complete inputs before consuming a new current single-use action of type installed_engine_mutation_v1 with action-installed-engine-mutation- prefix and exact canonical parameter_summary containing only kind/inputs_sha256. Under the existing shared task lock, atomically consume and reserve an exclusive launch claim. Any interrupted or failed attempt remains spent. Require only IMPLEMENTING, never manufacture VERIFYING or reopen blocked Node capability. Retain originals and namespace-specific completion; do not issue native targeted-mutation evidence.

Require parent bytecode writes disabled from interpreter startup before package imports; cold installed dependency preparation cannot write a pyc and then reject it. Parent isolated startup is not an extra condition. Each fixed pair runs fresh independent verified closure copies, retaining original RECORD and explicit mutation overlay. Execute the bound Windows x64 CPython 3.11 interpreter with -I -S -B and a fresh empty -X pycache_prefix, fixed copied-site root, fixed environment and bounded complete Job receipts. Confirm loaded engine/dependency/probe origins and bytes and actual guard references. Explicitly trust the supported interpreter standard library, loader and OS; do not claim hermetic or hostile-code isolation.

Bind each loaded module name to its legitimate copied-site module/package/supported-extension path, never another inventory file with a valid digest. Fixed harness stderr must be empty; an extra warning or traceback invalidates attribution even when stdout/exit1 look correct. The stdlib run_probe(probe_id) accepts only five fixed IDs. Fixed case order includes complete positive controls and designated negative controls. Report setup/call/teardown, observations and terminal exception traceback independently for each case, with complete terminal marker. Baseline requires exit0/all phases passed. A killed mutant requires exit1 and exactly its predeclared call-phase AssertionError at its bound source anchor, exact observations, other phases/cases passed and fully validated process/material facts. Exit1 alone is never killed. Survived, unrelated errors, changed loaded bytes, missing/ambiguous report, timeout/overflow/uncertain cleanup reject as unverified.

The new read-only authority collector accepts the exact closed reference and obtains state-neutral current task/Git/spec/classification/context/material facts; IMPLEMENTING remains only the prepare/record execution gate. Before historical data reaches a Git command, validate closed snapshot shapes, SHA syntax and path/ref/Git-directory roles. Exclude only the exact reference-owned run when gathering node._root_snapshot. Preserve ancestry, old-to-current and cached-diff restrictions to registered governance paths before using _git_audit_delta for exact physical Git allowances. Pure replay accepts InstalledMutationCurrent bound to the identical reference, then rereads bound inventories, namespace action/approval/consumption/launch/completion originals, canonical reports, receipts and raw streams. Preserve historical before==after and compare complete identity/files/task to the authoritative current snapshot, including full membership and byte/identity facts. Verify immutable review originals, approvals/events prefixes and exact registered governance advances. Include the required same-verifier IMPLEMENTING-to-VERIFYING verification_started transition with strict event replay; do not claim state-neutrality while rejecting that legitimate progression. Reuse pure _check_root_metadata with only registered governance files, collector-verified Git paths and the exact owned run; never exempt an entire Git/task/logs directory. It derives all five outcomes with no subprocess, recovery, mkdir or writes. Authority callers collect live Git facts outside the pure reader and must preserve that precondition; do not deserialize current authority from untrusted evidence. Dataclasses grant no authority. Missing, stale or malformed inputs reject with bounded reason codes.

## 非目标

No public Node V2/CI activation, Policy/profile/evidence version change, lifecycle adapters, target repository write, remote settings, authentication framework, arbitrary plugin/probe/operator/command/executable/environment API, native runner redesign, threshold reduction or authorization-file change. No source checkout or editable engine substitutes for ordinary wheel acceptance. Real target/model/WeChat/native engine acceptance is outside this slice.

## 验收条件

Run task-free test-baseline red/green regressions and focused source tests, Ruff, format, strict mypy and whitespace. Build direct wheel and sdist/rebuilt wheel, verify both package modules, and use a real ordinary installation outside the source import path for five actual baseline/mutant pairs. Independently replay original reports/receipts/materials. Demonstrate rehashed shortened files/metadata after changing an omitted original, cross-run Current reuse, malformed historical data before Git use, loaded-name/different-bound-path substitution, nonempty stderr and legitimate governance-only commits/state transitions. Include necessary portable Git/file/action/parser tests so Ubuntu required CI retains90percent source diff coverage; Windows-only actual execution cannot replace that gate. Demonstrate survived, unrelated assertions/import/setup/teardown failures, missing/duplicate/extra report fields, wrong engine, stale source/material/context/task/action, process failure, timeout/overflow/cleanup rejection, concurrency and interrupted single-use consumption. Pure reader tests forbid all subprocess APIs/process wrappers and detect filesystem writes. Record actual failures; no fabricated or mocked full PASS.

Then complete current native V2 verification with complete pytest, both production branch coverage domains at85percent total and90percent diff, every required check, the five unchanged native mutations under a separately current action, independent implementation review, same-verifier finalization and Gate. Required exact-head remote CI remains distinct and must pass before merge. This new task's mutation execution action is separate from the installed primitive's fixture actions and from spent TASK-0132/TASK-0133 actions or any prior fixture draft.

## 禁止动作

Preserve original checkout WIP, prior failed evidence, ignored owned materials and target work. No deployment, deletion of existing work, credentials/private export, model calls, paid calls, threshold reduction, repository-setting change, authorization edits, force push or rewritten history. All generated material, caches and temporary roots remain project-owned and preflighted.

## 错误行为

Reject unsupported hosts/layouts, source/editable substitutions, unknown probe/operator/case, ambiguous AST, unbound imported modules or stale cached bytecode, incomplete task/context/action authority, reused/concurrent/interrupted action, missing originals, mutation drift and uncertain process cleanup before any successful outcome. Failed recording retains evidence and spent authority; replay never retries or repairs.

## 回滚

Use a normal scoped revert while retaining append-only task/review/action/evidence history and owned acceptance originals. No target resource or unrelated work needs removal.
